title: Chapter 329: Protoss Arbitration Tribunal
content:
Chapter 329: Protoss Arbitration Tribunal

While the Zerg and Protoss joint army was fighting the Snow Demon Clan, the Zerg department responsible for handling weird affairs was also being established.

For such an organization responsible for activities in the hinterland of the native race camp, the Zerg arms are not suitable to participate. Only the Silkworm Knights who have been walking outside can work part-time as peripheral personnel in the Zerg's weird affairs handling department.

And the real core personnel are still the Protoss with strong spiritual power talents.

Google search TWKAN

Wu Qing did not act blindly. He first asked the Queen and the Archon to collect all the information related to weirdness, mutant weirdness, weird lords, etc., and conduct a detailed analysis. Then, combined with the actual research of the Zerg and Protoss on weirdness, he summarized a set of methods for using the Protoss's powerful spiritual power talents to identify various weirdness.

The initial version of this set of methods used by the Protoss to identify various weirdness was completed soon, and it will be continuously optimized and improved in the future.

By the way, the best app for reading and listening to books at present is the source change app, .huanyuanapp install the latest version.

Next, Wu Qing will give a name to the Zerg department responsible for handling strange affairs in order to promote it to the outside world.

Combining the characteristics of the Protoss, Wu Qing finally decided to use the name of the Arbitration Tribunal.

Wu Qing did not even add the prefix of the Zerg to the Arbitration Tribunal in order to give this organization a higher position.

The Arbitration Tribunal was a powerful organization for Wu Qing and the Protoss to directly intervene in various affairs of this world in the early stage of arbitration, which was considered an advance layout.

The members of the Arbitration Tribunal are all composed of various professions of the Protoss. The Protoss Berserker, the Protoss Dark Templar, the Protoss High Templar, the Archon of Light and the Archon of Darkness will all join this organization.

The weakest members of the Protoss are all seven-star, and professions such as the Archon of Light and the Archon of Darkness that need to be advanced once have an initial strength of eight-star.

This is an organization composed entirely of strong people, and there are not destined to be too many members. They will take the Protoss transport plane and go to various places in the native race camp through the space transmission channels of various races to deal with the mutated and strange affairs.

And some of the peripheral affairs of the Arbitration Tribunal will be handed over to the Silkworm Knight and the Silkworm Knight reserve personnel to handle.

Because the Zerg showed amazing strength, the Nine Changes of the Silkworm promoted by the Silkworm Knights was sought after by various races, and many large clans began to allow their clansmen to practice the Nine Changes of the Silkworm.

Those who used to wait and see now understand that with the current strength of the Zerg, promoting a set of skills to enhance the strength of ordinary people in the native race camp does not have much purpose except to gain a little fame.

Even if all the people who practiced the Nine Changes of the Silkworm were gathered together to form a large army, they would not be the opponent of any main force in the hands of the Zerg.

This is for the Zerg, but for the entire native race camp, in the long run, the number of people practicing the Nine Changes of the Silkworm will continue to increase, which is enough to reverse the overall weak strength of the native race camp.

As the reputation of the Zerg grows, many people who practiced the Nine Changes of the Silkworm are interested in joining the Zerg. The Silkworm Knights will select those who meet the conditions and make them the reserve personnel of the Silkworm Knights. After passing the layers of assessment, they can obtain the full set of equipment and mounts of the Silkworm Knights and officially become the Silkworm Knights.

Although these people are not very useful on the battlefield, they are still very useful in the hinterland of the native race camp.

…

After the Zerg's weird affairs handling department was established, Wu Qing handed over the relevant information.

The appearance of such a high-level arbitration tribunal immediately attracted great attention, and the native race camp immediately issued the arbitration tribunal the highest authority to pass and handle weird affairs.

After obtaining Wu Qing's consent, an area in the hinterland of the native race camp with the most rampant mutations and weirdness was designated as the station of the arbitration tribunal.

With the stationed arbitration tribunal, it is mainly responsible for the handling of the mutant weird affairs of the station. Of course, it can also handle weird affairs across regions as long as you have the ability.

A seven-star Protoss transport plane, carrying the advance personnel of the arbitration tribunal, passed through the space transmission channels of various races, and after many twists and turns, finally arrived at a super huge hinterland city of the native race camp.

Along the way, everyone was full of curiosity about the huge seven-star Protoss transport plane. The news of the establishment of the arbitration tribunal did not spread for a while, and everyone was guessing which race's powerful battlefield weapon it was.

Now Wu Qing no longer needs to think about publicity, as the local race camp will take the initiative to help with publicity.

As soon as the advance personnel of the Arbitration Tribunal arrived at the station city, they began to build Protoss buildings in the huge station assigned to them.

The seven-star Protoss transport plane is equipped with a seven-star Protoss detector, which can quickly locate the actual Protoss buildings.

Now Wu Qing no longer needs to hide the buildings of the Zerg and Protoss, especially the Protoss buildings, which can be regarded as special space transmission buildings. It does not look strange in this world.

Soon, a beautiful Protoss building with a mysterious style was built at the station of the Arbitration Tribunal, and the sign of the Arbitration Tribunal was also hung.

The notice issued by the local race camp on the establishment of the Arbitration Tribunal will soon spread to all local races and forces with a certain weight.

The mutant weirdness rampage area that the Arbitration Tribunal is responsible for was of course the first to get the news.

Through various effective mechanisms that already exist, a large amount of information about mutant weirdness has been gathered to the Arbitration Tribunal.

A large number of Protoss members were materialized through various Protoss buildings.

Several Light Archons and Dark Archons whose bodies were completely spiritualized also came to the Arbitration Court.

Although the bodies of the Light and Dark Archons were spiritualized, they did not look much different from other Protoss members.

The bodies of Protoss members were almost all protected by exclusive equipment. From the outside, they only had equipment differences.

The spiritualized bodies of the Light Archons and Dark Archons were hidden in their exclusive equipment, which was no different from other Protoss members, not the exaggerated energy explosion state in the game.

The spiritual power of the two Archons was extremely strong. The Light Archons were better at attacking, and the Dark Archons were better at fine control of spiritual power. They each had their own strengths.

In particular, the Dark Archons' mental control, feedback and vortex were all very powerful abilities.

The first thing the Arbitration Court did when it opened was to clear all the mutants hidden in the city.

In this area, the mutants were constantly infiltrated and could be said to be hidden very deeply. As long as they did not cause any major incidents, basically no one could discover their existence.

There are honest mutants, but there are more mutants that like to make trouble. There are also many powerful mutants that act completely on instinct, and they will cause shocking events at any time.

No matter what kind of mutants, the arbitration tribunal must find them.

Unmanned probe spacecraft flew out of the arbitration tribunal's station and flew to various parts of the city, hovering in the sky, monitoring all the movements in the city.

The Protoss can discover most of the hidden mutants through unmanned probe spacecraft. A small number of mutants that are no different from normal creatures require the Protoss with strong spiritual power to distinguish.

Wu Qing has a personal experience of the mutants in this world through the intelligence collected by the arbitration tribunal.

"This mutant weirdness makes this place a bit like the world of Liaozhai where demons and monsters are rampant!"

Wu Qing has this idea because the mutants are so strange and weird, and the things they do are even more outrageous, which really looks like a new and strange story from Liaozhai.

The weak mutants, with a certain degree of intelligence, will use various means to obtain a place to survive in this world. Many smart ones will also blend into the city and live the life of normal intelligent creatures.

Those mutants that are weak, not very intelligent, and can only act on instinct generally cannot survive for a long time and will be destroyed by other creatures due to various things.

This kind of mutants is the most numerous and does not cause much harm, but ordinary people are most afraid of this kind of weirdness, because there are many of them, it is easy to encounter them, and ordinary people cannot deal with them, and often their lives are in danger.

Some of the mutants with strong strength or special abilities choose to integrate into this world, while others choose to act on instinct and do whatever they want.

No matter which choice, as long as these powerful mutants do something, it will have a huge impact, and often bring great losses to the hinterland of the local ethnic camp.

In this city, beggars on the roadside, beautiful women next door, butchers at the street corner, masters of a certain family, and officials may all be mutants.

Most of the murders that happen every day are caused by mutants.

The mutants have a huge impact on this area. Ordinary races have no way to deal with such incidents. They cannot distinguish mutants from normal creatures.

…

After the Arbitration Tribunal collected information about the entire city, a large number of seven-star Protoss Berserkers and seven-star Protoss Dark Templars were dispatched.

Holding the token representing the Arbitration Tribunal, they first killed all the mutants whose identities had been confirmed.

For a while, some residents in the city suddenly found that some familiar people around them disappeared and never appeared again.

For those mutants that have not been found to have committed evil deeds for the time being, the Arbitration Tribunal arrested them all.

Wu Qing does not discriminate against those mutants who want to be normal creatures, but who really wants to be a good weird and who is pretending to be a good weird, Wu Qing does not want to waste time to distinguish, so he can only catch them all.

These mutants are in the hands of the Protoss, especially the hands of the Dark Archon, whether they are good or bad, you can tell at a glance.

Most of the mutants, if they are caught by the Arbitration Tribunal, don't think about getting out again.

But there are some very special mutants that have already established families and careers in this world and integrated into ordinary life. For these harmless mutants, the Arbitration Tribunal imposed a mental power shackle on them, which was considered to give them a legal body, and then put them back.

For those mutants that are hidden very deeply, and some powerful mutants that control a considerable part of the power in the city, the Arbitration Tribunal needs the local race camp to come forward and appease the local officials before taking action.

Otherwise, every action of the Arbitration Tribunal will have a great impact.

…

In the city where the Arbitration Tribunal is located, there is an organization with a very powerful influence, and its power has touched all aspects of the city.

The top leaders of the organization are very mysterious and almost never show up, but the important members of the organization are all well-informed people in the city, and some are even important official figures.

Such an organization has existed for a very long time, accumulated huge connections and countless wealth, and has become an indispensable part of this city.

No one has ever thought that there will be any problems with this organization.

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading the exciting content!

According to the intelligence Wu Qing collected from the Protoss, this mysterious organization is one of the largest mutant and weird forces in this area.

This mysterious organization has organized all the mutants that have infiltrated various important locations in this city, forming a joint force that is enough to change the development direction of the entire city.

If there is no external intervention, and they are allowed to continue to develop like this, this area will gradually become a sphere of influence for mutants and weirds.

Even now, it is very difficult for the forces of the general local race camp to move them. They are enough to mobilize enough resources to fight a civil war with the forces that want to deal with them.

However, such a threat has no effect on the Protoss Arbitration Tribunal, which has absolute power.

The Protoss Arbitration Tribunal sent a large number of personnel to arrest important personnel of the entire organization, and the Archons of Light and Darkness personally took action to arrest the strongest and most hidden veterans of the organization.

The ultimate troop of the Zerg can kill enemies above their level, and the ultimate troop of the Protoss is no exception. As long as they are not facing powerful enemies, the eight-star strength of the Protoss Light Archon and Dark Archon are invincible.

When the nine-star mutant who had been hiding his identity and enjoying being a small chef in a restaurant, the real behind-the-scenes manipulator of the entire organization, was instantly controlled by the eight-star Protoss Light Archon and Dark Archon, this mutant weird organization that had existed for who knows how many years was completely eliminated by the Protoss Arbitration Tribunal.

The Protoss Arbitration Tribunal did not touch the normal creatures in the organization, and even released the mutant weird that had been controlled by the eight-star Protoss Dark Archon back to the organization to help the Arbitration Tribunal continue to control the operation of the organization.

In addition to being controlled by the mutant weird, the organization still has a very large role in the entire city and can continue to exist.

It's just that the hidden dangers behind the scenes were eliminated by the Protoss Arbitration Tribunal.

All kinds of mutant weird organizations and forces that were hidden very deeply were eliminated by the Protoss Arbitration Tribunal using the same method.

The atmosphere of the entire city has become somewhat different.

The Protoss Arbitration Court, with this city as its center, has begun to rapidly develop throughout the region, and then radiated to the entire hinterland of the native race camp.
